_doc: GAB v1.3 configuration (see GAB.md). sets = named clip sets that earlier reports used, scored as their own rows so an old number can be reproduced on its own clips. A set matches manifest rows by suite (any suite_jobs entry '<suite>:'), optional folder prefix and optional split. coldFirst = suites whose clips were cut from inside a performance: the first Shabad/Bani is already being sung at t=0, so its find time is measured from t=0 (the app was started while it was sung), never from the truth window start. exclude = clips left out of every number, with the reason (dataset truth to fix). expectBanis = the Banis each behaviour should cover (the user's list); a Bani with no clip shows as 'no clips yet'. tiers = which recordings each GAB tier scores (data, not code): a tier with `gurdwara` takes the manifest rows whose gurdwara matches that regex (case-insensitive); a tier with `excludeTiers` takes every row that is in none of those tiers. A tier rule may also match a tag in the row's notes (`notes` regex), so new recordings join a tier from their manifest row. `gab run` / `compare` score the main tier unless `--set hard` / `--set akhand` (or `gab hard ...` / `gab akhand ...`); tiers are never mixed in one scorecard or compare. A set with `tier` is a row only in that tier.

coldFirst.l2: the sheet's start is a labelled pangti inside the Shabad; the 30 s before it is the same Shabad
coldFirst.paath: 70 s cuts from a continuous reading; the scored window (30-60 s) is in the middle of it
coldFirst.aarti: cuts that start at many points inside one sung Aarti
coldFirst.asa: a cut from inside a sung Asa di Vaar

hard.title: GAB-Hard (Fremont hall, laptop mic)
hard.doc: Jaspal's STTM Desktop recordings at Gurdwara Sahib Fremont (kh01-kh32): a resonant hall, the laptop mic far from the ragis, little clean audio. Tracked, not the priority (user decision Oct 14 2026). The Fremont YouTube livestream clips (clip04-clip09, mixer feed) stay in main: add 'Fremont' without '(Jaspal)' here to move them.

akhand.title: GAB-Akhand Kirtan (smagam, many singers)
akhand.doc: Akhand Kirtan smagams (AKJ Toronto 2022, Manchester 2024 Rehnsabhai; Level 3 of the human sheet): 5-15 singers, the sangat singing along, many instruments, a resonant sound. Its own tier (user, Oct 14 2026), never mixed with main GAB or GAB-Hard; tracked, never used to tune (level3 policy). Rule = data, not ids: a manifest row joins when its gurdwara/source names AKJ, Akhand Kirtan or a Rehnsabhai/Rainsabai, or its notes carry the tag `tags: akhand-kirtan`.
